privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Learn how B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacyPolicy.heroSubtitle: We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data to the highest standards.
privacyPolicy.intro: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam ('we', 'us') values your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our online ticketing service at bduck-cityfuns.vn.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content:
We collect the following information when you use our services:

• Account information: Full name, email address, and phone number when you register or purchase tickets.
• Transaction data: Order details, payment method (we do not store card numbers), and QR e-ticket codes.
• Device information: IP address, browser type, operating system, and browsing behavior via cookies.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content:
The information we collect is used to:

• Process and confirm ticket purchase transactions.
• Deliver QR e-tickets via email.
• Improve our service experience and provide customer support.
• Send promotional notifications (you may unsubscribe at any time).
• Comply with applicable legal obligations.

sharing.title: Sharing Information with Third Parties
sharing.content:
We do not sell or rent your personal information. However, we may share it with:

• Payment processing partners (e.g., payment gateways) to complete transactions.
• Email service providers to send tickets and notifications.
• Legal authorities when required under Vietnamese law.

security.title: Data Security
security.content:
We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:

• HTTPS encryption for all connections.
• Storing data on certified secure cloud infrastructure (Google Firebase).
• Strict internal access controls for staff.

However, no system can guarantee absolute security.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content:
Our website uses cookies to:

• Maintain your login session.
• Remember your cart and language preferences.
• Analyze traffic (Google Analytics).

You may disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect some features of our service.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content:
You have the right to:

• Access and view the personal information we hold about you.
• Request correction of inaccurate information.
• Request deletion of your account and personal data.
• Object to the processing of your data for marketing purposes.

To exercise these rights, please contact: ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn

contact.title: Privacy Contact
contact.content:
If you have questions about our privacy policy, please contact:

📧 Email: ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn
📍 Address: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam, Vietnam

We will respond within 5 business days.

privacyPolicy.footerNote: This privacy policy may be updated periodically. The latest version is always published on this page.

termsOfService.metaTitle: Terms of Use — B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam
termsOfService.metaDescription: Read the terms and conditions for using B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam's online ticketing service.
termsOfService.heroSubtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam' ticketing service.
termsOfService.intro: By using the website and ticketing services of B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam ('we', 'us'), you agree to comply with the Terms of Use set out below. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By purchasing tickets or creating an account on our website, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms of Use. Users under 18 years of age must have the consent of a parent or legal guardian.

tickets.title: Ticket Purchase and Use
tickets.content:
• QR e-tickets are sent via email upon successful payment.
• Each ticket may only be used once. It will be automatically voided after scanning.
• Open-dated tickets (without a fixed visit date) are valid according to the policy stated on the ticket.
• Do not share your QR code with others to prevent misuse.
• We reserve the right to reject counterfeit or misused tickets.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content:
• Ticket prices displayed include VAT where applicable.
• Payments are processed through a secure payment gateway. We do not store credit card information.
• The final price is confirmed by our server — if there is a discrepancy, you will be notified before the transaction is completed.
• Counter payment: Orders are valid for 24 hours from the time of placement.

refund.title: Refunds and Cancellations
refund.content:
• Tickets that have been successfully paid for and QR codes issued are non-refundable, except in cases of technical error on our part.
• If you experience a technical issue, please contact support within 24 hours of the incident.
• B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam reserves the right to refuse refund requests for tickets that have been used or have expired.

conduct.title: Code of Conduct
conduct.content:
When visiting and using our services, you agree to:

• Comply with the rules and regulations of the entertainment venue.
• Refrain from any disruptive, violent, or threatening behavior.
• Not use our services for any unlawful purposes.
• Ensure children are accompanied by an adult (18+) who is responsible for them.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content:
• B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam is not liable for indirect damages arising from the use of our services.
• We do not guarantee uninterrupted service availability, which may be affected by maintenance or technical issues.
• Our maximum liability is limited to the actual transaction value of the relevant order.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to update these Terms of Use at any time. The latest version will be published on this page with the date of update. Continued use of our services after changes are made constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

governing.title: Governing Law
governing.content:
These Terms are governed by the laws of Vietnam. Any disputes arising shall be resolved in the competent courts of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

For any questions, please contact: ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn

termsOfService.footerNote: By using our services, you agree to these Terms of Use. © 2026 B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam.

purchaseGuide.metaTitle: How to Buy Tickets — B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam
purchaseGuide.metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to purchasing e-tickets at B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam. Choose, pay, and receive your QR code instantly.
purchaseGuide.heroSubtitle: Just a few simple steps to get your e-ticket — secure payment, instant QR code delivery.
purchaseGuide.intro: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam provides a convenient, fast, and secure online ticketing service. Your QR e-ticket will be sent directly to your email right after a successful payment — no printing required.

browse.title: Step 1: Choose Your Ticket
browse.content:
Visit the Tickets page (click 'Tickets' in the navigation bar) to browse all available tickets and combos.

• Single tickets: For individual rides or attractions.
• Combo packages: Bundles of multiple sessions at a discounted price.
• Filter by product group or search by name to find the right ticket.
• Click on a ticket card to view the full description, price, and remaining stock.

cart.title: Step 2: Add to Cart
cart.content:
Once you've found your ticket, click the 'Add to Cart' button on the product card.

• You can add multiple different ticket types to a single cart.
• The cart icon in the navigation bar shows the current number of items.
• Click the cart icon to review and edit your selections before checkout.

info.title: Step 3: Enter Buyer Information
info.content:
On the checkout page, fill in the following details:

• Full name (buyer or ticket recipient)
• Email address — your QR ticket will be sent here, please double-check.
• Phone number.
• Promo code (if any): Enter it in the 'Promo Code' field and click 'Apply'.

payment.title: Step 4: Select Payment Method
payment.content:
B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam supports the following payment methods:

• Online payment: Domestic cards, international cards (Visa/Mastercard), e-wallets, QR Pay.
• Pay at Counter: Select this option to receive an order QR code, then bring it to the cashier and pay by cash or bank transfer.

Review the order summary and total amount before confirming.

receive.title: Step 5: Receive Your E-Ticket
receive.content:
After successful payment:

• Your QR ticket will be sent to the email you provided within a few seconds to 5 minutes.
• You can also view your ticket in 'My Orders' when logged in.
• If you don't receive the email, check your Spam/Junk folder first.
• Use the 'Resend Email' button on the order detail page if needed.

use.title: Step 6: Use Your Ticket at the Park
use.content:
When you arrive at B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam:

• Open your email or go to 'My Orders' to retrieve your QR code.
• Present the QR code at the ticket counter to exchange for a paper ticket (if applicable) or scan directly at the entrance.
• Each QR code can only be used once.
• Take a screenshot of the QR code for offline use in case you have no internet access.

support.title: Support & Contact
support.content:
If you encounter any issues during the ticket purchase process:

📧 Email: ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn
📞 Hotline: At the cashier counter at the park
🕐 Support hours: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM daily

Our team will respond within 2 business hours.

purchaseGuide.footerNote: Need more help? Don't hesitate to contact us at ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn.

deliveryPolicy.metaDescription: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam e-ticket delivery policy. Receive your QR code instantly via email after successful payment.
deliveryPolicy.heroSubtitle: E-tickets delivered instantly to your inbox — no waiting, no printing.
deliveryPolicy.intro: Due to the nature of our service, B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam delivers tickets exclusively in digital format (e-tickets). Tickets are delivered directly to the customer's email address after a successful payment — completely free and instantaneous.

method.title: Ticket Delivery Method
method.content:
B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam uses electronic ticket (e-ticket) delivery exclusively:

• QR tickets are sent to the email address provided at the time of order.
• Physical delivery (paper tickets by mail) is not available.
• Delivery fee: Completely free.
• Customers can also view their tickets in 'My Orders' after logging in.

timeline.title: Delivery Timeline
timeline.content:
• Successful online payment: Ticket sent within 30 seconds – 5 minutes.
• Counter payment: Ticket sent immediately after the cashier confirms payment.
• During high system load: Maximum 15 minutes.

If you haven't received your ticket after 15 minutes, please check your Spam/Junk folder or contact support.

scope.title: Coverage
scope.content:
• Applies to all orders placed on bduck-cityfuns.vn.
• E-tickets can be used at all B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam locations in Vietnam.
• No geographic restrictions on email delivery — customers anywhere can order tickets.

notreceived.title: Didn't Receive Your Ticket?
notreceived.content:
If you haven't received your ticket after 15 minutes, follow these steps:

1. Check your Spam/Junk/Trash folder in your email client.
2. Search for emails from noreply@bduck-cityfuns.vn.
3. Go to 'My Orders' on the website to check your order status.
4. Click 'Resend Email' if the order status shows 'Successful'.
5. If still not received, contact ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn with your order ID.

notes.title: Important Notes
notes.content:
• Please enter your email address accurately at checkout — we are not responsible for tickets sent to an incorrectly typed email.
• Each QR ticket can only be used once and will be automatically voided after scanning.
• We recommend screenshotting your QR code or saving the ticket URL for offline use.
• Do not share your QR code with others before using it.

deliveryPolicy.footerNote: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam e-tickets — convenient, instant, and eco-friendly.

paymentMethods.metaDescription: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam supports online and counter payment. Multiple secure payment options available.
paymentMethods.heroSubtitle: Flexible, secure, and convenient payment options for every customer.
paymentMethods.intro: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam supports a variety of payment methods to accommodate all customers. All transactions are SSL-encrypted and processed through trusted payment gateways, ensuring absolute security.

online.title: Online Payment
online.content:
We support the following online payment methods:

• Domestic bank cards (ATM/Napas): Most Vietnamese banks.
• International cards: Visa, Mastercard, JCB, American Express.
• E-wallets: MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay, Moca.
• QR Pay: Scan via banking apps or e-wallet apps.
• Internet Banking: Online transfers via banking apps.

Online transactions are processed instantly — tickets sent to your email right after confirmation.

counter.title: Pay at Counter
counter.content:
For customers who prefer to pay in person at the park:

1. Add items to cart and place an order on the website, selecting 'Pay at Counter'.
2. Receive an order QR code — valid for 24 hours.
3. Bring the QR code to the B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam cashier counter.
4. Staff will scan the code and display your order details.
5. Pay by Cash or Bank Transfer.
6. Your e-ticket will be sent to your email right after.

promo.title: Promo Codes & Discounts
promo.content:
• Enter your promo code in the 'Promo Code' field during the checkout process.
• Click 'Apply' to validate and see the discount amount.
• Only one promo code can be applied per order.
• Promo codes may have expiration dates or specific conditions.
• Promo codes have no cash value and cannot be exchanged.

security.title: Payment Security
security.content:
Every transaction at B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam is protected by:

• 256-bit SSL encryption for all connections.
• PCI-DSS compliance for payment industry standards.
• No storage of customer payment card information.
• Server-side price confirmation — cannot be altered client-side.
• Automatic anomalous transaction detection system.

notes.title: Important Notes
notes.content:
• Ticket prices displayed on the website include VAT where applicable.
• Counter payment orders are valid for a maximum of 24 hours from placement.
• If a payment is declined, please check your account balance or contact your bank.
• For transaction disputes, contact ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn with your order ID and proof of payment.

paymentMethods.footerNote: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam is committed to providing the safest and most convenient payment experience for our customers.

returnPolicy.metaTitle: Warranty & Return Policy — B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam
returnPolicy.metaDescription: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam e-ticket refund and exchange policy. Transparent, fair, and customer-first.
returnPolicy.heroSubtitle: We are committed to transparency and protecting our customers' rights in every situation.
returnPolicy.intro: B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam respects customer rights and maintains a clear policy on e-ticket exchanges and refunds. Due to the digital nature of e-tickets, the return policy has specific conditions outlined below.

conditions.title: Refund Eligibility
conditions.content:
You may request a refund in the following cases:

✅ System technical error: Ticket was not generated after a successful charge.
✅ Ticket sent to wrong email: Due to a system error (not caused by the customer entering incorrect details).
✅ Event cancelled by B.Duck Cityfuns Vietnam: A full 100% refund will be issued.
✅ Incorrect ticket pricing: The difference between the displayed price and actual price will be refunded.

process.title: Refund Request Process
process.content:
Follow these steps to request a ticket refund:

1. Email ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn with the subject: [REFUND REQUEST] + Order ID.
2. Provide: Full name, booking email, order ID, and reason for refund request.
3. Attach supporting evidence if available (error screenshots, payment receipts).
4. Our team will review and respond within 1–2 business days.
5. If approved, the refund will be returned to the original payment method.

timeline.title: Refund Processing Time
timeline.content:
• Request review: 1–2 business days from receiving complete information.
• Approval and processing: 3–5 business days.
• Funds returned to account/card: 5–15 business days depending on bank/e-wallet.

Total maximum time: 7–20 business days from when the request is approved.

exceptions.title: Non-Refundable Cases
exceptions.content:
We do not support refunds in the following cases:

🚫 Ticket has already been scanned/used at the park.
🚫 Customer entered the wrong email and the ticket was successfully sent to that address.
🚫 Ticket has expired according to the validity stated on the ticket.
🚫 Customer changes their mind after successfully receiving the ticket.
🚫 Ticket was shared with a third party and has been used.
🚫 Request submitted more than 24 hours after a technical issue occurred.

contact.title: Refund Support Contact
contact.content:
📧 Email: ask@bduckcifyfuns.com.vn
📝 Email subject: [REFUND REQUEST] + Order ID
🕐 Processing hours: Monday – Saturday, 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Please provide complete information so we can process your request as quickly as possible. We are committed to resolving all complaints fairly and transparently.

returnPolicy.footerNote: This policy complies with the regulations of Vietnam's Ministry of Industry and Trade on consumer protection in e-commerce.
